meta: In one class, some finish in five minutes and some still don't get the task, and there's only one teacher. AI writes three versions of an exercise and new explanations; the teacher chooses.

muc.title: One class, three levels
muc.text: In one class, some students finish in five minutes, some still don't understand the task, and there's only one teacher.

muc.title: One exercise, three versions
muc.text: Ask AI to rewrite the same exercise in three versions: one with step-by-step hints, a standard one, and an advanced one for fast students.

muc.title: Many ways to explain
muc.text: For students who don't get it, ask AI for another way to explain: with a drawing, an everyday example, or a short story.

muc.title: The teacher stays in charge
muc.text: The teacher chooses which version goes to which student, because only the teacher knows what each student needs.

muc.title: Try it with two groups
muc.text: Take a hard exercise from this week, ask AI for a hint version and an advanced version, then try them with two groups.
